map.输入榫卯类型、木材材质与板厚，计算榫头的长、宽、深等尺寸，适配不同连接方式，用于: Enter joint type, wood species and board thickness to compute tenon length, width and depth, adapting to different connections, for designing and cutting traditional mortise-and-tenon woodwork.
map.家具榫卯设计：根据板厚、板宽与榫型（贯通榫/半榫/燕尾榫/明榫/暗榫/搭接榫）推: Furniture mortise-and-tenon design: derive tenon thickness, width, depth and shoulder width from board thickness, board width and joint type (through/half/dovetail/exposed/concealed/lapped), balancing strength and appearance.
map.不同木材强度补偿：软木榫头易松动，按硬度系数放大榫厚；硬木则可适当收紧。: Compensating for different wood strengths: softwood tenons loosen easily, so scale up tenon thickness by the hardness factor; hardwood can be tightened appropriately.

map.示例：贯通榫 板厚25mm / 板宽100mm / 中硬木: Example: through tenon, board thickness 25 mm / board width 100 mm / medium hardwood
map.：榫厚 = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10mm（板厚 40%）；榫宽 =: : tenon thickness = 25 x 0.4 x 1.0 = 10 mm (40% of board thickness); tenon width = 100 x 0.7 = 70 mm (70% of board width); tenon depth = 25 x 3.0 = 75 mm (full through penetration); shoulder width on each side = (100 - 70) / 2 = 15 mm; cheek height top and bottom = (25 - 10) / 2 = 8 mm.
map.榫厚一般取板厚的多少？: How thick should a tenon be relative to board thickness?
map.常用经验为板厚的 1/3–1/2（本工具对多数榫型取 0.33–0.6 的系数）: A common rule is 1/3-1/2 of board thickness (this tool uses coefficients of 0.33-0.6 for most joint types). Too thin breaks easily, too thick weakens the parent stock; about 0.4 is safe for through tenons.
map.软木和硬木的系数怎么调？: How are the softwood and hardwood factors adjusted?
map.工具以硬度系数补偿：软木 1.1（榫厚略增防松）、中硬 1.0、硬木 0.9。硬: The tool compensates with a hardness factor: softwood 1.1 (slightly thicker tenons to prevent loosening), medium 1.0, hardwood 0.9. Hardwood is strong enough to allow tighter fits, while softwood needs extra thickness or wedges.
map.燕尾榫的 14° 角度有什么讲究？: Why does the dovetail use 14 degrees?
map.燕尾角通常 8°–14°，角度越大咬合越紧、越不易拉脱，但加工与装配难度也上升。: Dovetail angles are usually 8-14 degrees; the larger the angle the tighter the grip and the harder it pulls out, but machining and assembly get harder. This tool uses 14 degrees for dovetails, balancing strength and assemblability.
